facts.fact: The Burundi Council of Ministers, meeting on 14 October 2026, adopted the National Cybersecurity Strategy, according to the Primature's communique.
The Burundi Council of Ministers, meeting on 14 October 2026, recorded the adoption of the draft (projet de) National Digital Policy, according to the Primature's communique.

BDI.note: Council examined mobilising private investment, but no amount or deal is stated.
